# Periodic reward from ASSS 1.4.4 src/scoring/points_periodic.c (compiled unmodified),
# the per-freq points that scoring/periodic.c puts in S2C 0x23 and adds as flag points.
# periodic <Periodic:RewardPoints> <flags owned> <total players in arena> <points>
# Positive RewardPoints: flags * points. Zero or negative: flags * -points * players,
# so 0 always scores 0. periodic.c only fires at all when the arena has at least
# Periodic:RewardMinimumPlayers players, and skips players in spec or a safe zone.
periodic -10 0 1 0
periodic -10 0 2 0
